# Scooter

> Scooter is a Dubai, UAE media and video production company creating culturally fluent, visually ambitious content for brands and organizations across the United Arab Emirates and worldwide.

## Official website

- [Scooter — Media and Video Production Company](https://www.scootermedia.co/): Company overview, selected work, clients, team, press coverage, contact details and global locations.

## Services

- Film and video production
- Commercial and branded content production
- Corporate film production
- Photography production
- Social video and digital content
- Animation, CGI and post-production
- AI filmmaking and emerging production technology
- UAE production services and international production support

## Locations

- Dubai: Building A1, Dubai Digital Park, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Mumbai: WeWork, Enam Sambhav, C-20 G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai, India
- Vancouver, Canada

Scooter was founded in 2013. The Dubai business operates as Scooter Media Collective – FZCO.
